goal: Finance flagged orders where stacked coupons gave absurd discounts, a few even came out negative and triggered refunds — see logs/orders-2026-09-20.txt. Find out what's going on in the coupon logic. No edits yet, just investigate and report back.
prompts: Thanks. Finance's rules for the fix: only one percentage coupon counts per order, the largest; any others are ignored and shouldn't show up in `applied`. The percentage comes off the subtotal before any fixed-amount coupons. The total can never go below zero. applyCoupons(cart, codes) must keep returning { total, applied } in integer cents, the checkout UI and the receipts service both read it. Unknown codes stay ignored. Check what else calls applyCoupons with that in mind. Still no edits.

Finance came back after looking at the numbers: fixed-amount coupons together can take off at most half of the subtotal (the subtotal before any coupons). And a code entered more than once only counts once. Summarize the fix you plan to make and which tests would change. No edits yet.
